reviews.title: Used to be Free
reviews.text: I hate it when apps that were free suddenly decide to block all their functionality behind a paywall. I have 5 lists which isn’t a lot, and I cannot add any new ones. It used to be fine with plenty of free options and adding as many items on your lists as you wanted.

reviews.title: Used to be Free
reviews.text: This app used to be perfect but the new update now requires payment. Will be searching for another app.

reviews.title: Free app?
reviews.text: Not free. Try for a week then you’re locked out and given a price to continue. If it’s free, it’s free! If it’s only during a trial period then just say so! Misleading!

reviews.title: New Fees
reviews.text: Loved this App for years - now all of a sudden I’m being charged to create a new list.  Will be moving on to a new App

reviews.title: Not what it used to be
reviews.text: Used this app for years but now everything is stuck behind a paywall. I tried to delete my list (thinking I was at the maximum) and now I am not longer able to create new lists without paying. I will be looking to use a different app now.

reviews.title: Displeased with update
reviews.text: I used to be able to have more lists. At first when I got the message to pay if I wanted to creat another list I thought I just reached the max so I cleared space by deleting lists I was not using. Only it still did not let me creat a new list. I should have just kept all my old lists renamed them and deleted the contents. The only reasons I had started using this app to begin with is because it did everything I needed for free. Now that  is not true.

reviews.title: Why is it purchase locked?
reviews.text: This simple and practical app is perfect for the buy me a coffee approach but now it is effectively non functional without purchasing needless add ons. I can no longer duplicate or add lists. There is no indication of a limited number of free lists. There Hopefully the developer will rethink this.

reviews.title: Money Hungry
reviews.text: I have used this free app for years! Why would you do this to your loyal app users?????

reviews.title: September 2026, can’t add another list
reviews.text:
I have been using this app for a couple of years now. I have really liked it but, Today, September 28, 2026, I went to add list, either press the Plus or Duplicate a list, and it brings me to a pop up ad spot to buy some kind of colors/extra feature expansion pack. I don’t care about that stuff. I just want to add a new list like I do for every month. It will not let me. I only using a basic function, and don’t want or need that extra stuff.
    I thought maybe I reached the limit of how many lists I can have, so I deleted a bunch  and I still can’t add a new one. I don’t want to buy some expansions stuff, I don’t need those features. It doesn’t have any other options or info about why I can’t add a new list. What gives?

reviews.title: New Glitch
reviews.text: This used to be a brilliant app. Did exactly what it said on the tin! Unfortunately the new update has placed a limit on the number of lists you can make. So I deleted a whole bunch of my lists so I could make more. Turns out that the limit means that no matter how many lists you have, even if you delete all of them, you can no longer create a new list. This is such a shame!

reviews.title: Bummed about the pay wall
reviews.text: I’m devastated that they put a limit with a pay wall to the amount of lists…this app has been a go to for me for many years :(

reviews.title: Used to be free
reviews.text: This app used to be free which made it awesome now you can’t use it at ALL without paying .

reviews.title: Suddenly charging?
reviews.text: Why after I’ve had this app for 4 years are you guys making it so if I want to add a new list I have to pay? I’ll be looking for a new app to use & I LOVED this app.

reviews.title: Was great until
reviews.text: Was great until they added a paywall to make any new lists. Even tried deleting old one to make room and still won’t let me make new lists without paying. Sad.

reviews.title: Charging Now?
reviews.text:
I tried to add a new list and I keep getting a thing telling me to pay $1.99. 

Is this no longer free?

reviews.title: Where the Hell is the “New list” button?!
reviews.text: I want to make a new list, but I can’t find the “New list” button anywhere! WHERE THE HELL IS THE “NEW LIST” BUTTON?!😡

reviews.title: No longer free
reviews.text:
Used this app for a while now and suddenly can’t add any new lists any longer unless I pay to unlock features.  I have no issues with paying for apps, just not after they have been installed as “free” and used as such for extensive periods of time. I’ll  be looking for another app at this point if they are going to pull the rug out from under its users all of a sudden . 

I call absolute B.S about their recent “update” to fix a “sync issue”.  Never had a sync issue before. Just an excuse to get the app to update to this new locked version. Well played, I’ll just be playing somewhere else now.

reviews.title: Tricked
reviews.text: Early on I was so impressed I gave it 5 stars. Now after using it for 6 weeks and a dozen notes you froze the app and my only option is to pay for it. If I pay for it are there any other surprises down the road? I don’t trust this developer.

reviews.title: Pay for dark mode?
reviews.text: If I have to pay for dark mode it’s an immediate 1 star (0 star if I could) … horrible pay scheme auto-delete
